facts.statement: A turn's first phase is a dice roll and resolution phase in which the player rolls their available dice.
facts.sourceSentence: PHASE I: DICE ROLL / RESOLUTION - On each turn, you will roll your available dice, and allocate them in various ways to modify your rolls, defend against incoming damage, and deal damage to parts of the Doom Machine.

facts.statement: Rolled dice are allocated for several purposes: modifying rolls, defending against incoming damage, and dealing damage to Doom Machine parts.
facts.sourceSentence: PHASE I: DICE ROLL / RESOLUTION - On each turn, you will roll your available dice, and allocate them in various ways to modify your rolls, defend against incoming damage, and deal damage to parts of the Doom Machine.

facts.statement: The machine phase begins only after the player has allocated and resolved all of their dice.
facts.sourceSentence: PHASE II: THE MACHINE PHASE - Once you have allocated and resolved all of your dice, the machine will cycle its remaining parts, resolve their effects, then grow by 1 additional card.

facts.statement: During the machine phase the machine cycles its remaining parts and resolves their effects.
facts.sourceSentence: PHASE II: THE MACHINE PHASE - Once you have allocated and resolved all of your dice, the machine will cycle its remaining parts, resolve their effects, then grow by 1 additional card.

facts.statement: After cycling and resolving its parts, the machine grows by one additional card.
facts.sourceSentence: PHASE II: THE MACHINE PHASE - Once you have allocated and resolved all of your dice, the machine will cycle its remaining parts, resolve their effects, then grow by 1 additional card.

facts.statement: The phase loop repeats until one of two end conditions occurs: the player reveals and destroys the Doom Core, or the machine destroys the player.
facts.sourceSentence: This loop continues until either you have revealed and destroyed the Doom Core or you are destroyed by the machine.

facts.statement: Destroying the Doom Core requires first revealing it.
facts.sourceSentence: This loop continues until either you have revealed and destroyed the Doom Core or you are destroyed by the machine.

facts.statement: At the beginning of the player's turn, all of the player's available dice are rolled.
facts.sourceSentence: At the start of your turn, roll all of your available dice (you start with 5 black dice and may gain up to 5 additional yellow dice from destroyed machine part cards).

facts.statement: The player's starting dice pool is five black dice.
The player can acquire as many as five extra yellow dice over the course of play.

facts.statement: Yellow dice are obtained from destroyed machine part cards.
